title.en: DSH Plugin Market · curated by 插件市场deepseek
title.zh: DSH 插件市场 · 人工审核版

description.en: Human-reviewed index for DeepSeek Harness plugins. Only entries whose package declares a bundle patch are listed.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的人工审核插件索引；仅收录在 package.json 中声明了 bundle patch 的包。

title.zh: 分类由关键词自动推断
鲸挑细选 · 同需求多方案对比

description.en: Run one request as 2-4 parallel variants in the main conversation, compare answers, files or live pages, then adopt the one you prefer.
description.zh: 把同一个需求交给 2–4 个版本并行做，在主对话里比较回答、文件和可运行网页，盲选或公开对比后再采纳。

description.en: Turns SSH hosts into DSH workspaces: remote file tree, highlighted editing, recursive search, terminals and Git diffs, with the agent working in the remote directory.
description.zh: 把 SSH 主机变成 DSH 工作区：远程文件树、高亮编辑、递归搜索、终端与 Git 差异，Agent 直接在远端目录里读写、构建和测试。

description.en: Per-session, per-model cost and token accounting, with a 170+ model price catalogue, subscription-quota lookups, budgets and peak/off-peak reminders.
description.zh: 按会话与模型统计费用和 Token，内置 170+ 模型价格目录，可查多家订阅额度，并支持预算提醒与峰谷时段提示。

title.zh: 免 Key 多引擎搜索

description.en: Registers a web-search provider with 40 switchable engines and automatic fallback, so search no longer depends on the official DeepSeek key.
description.zh: 注册一个可切换 40 个引擎的搜索 provider 并自动回退，让 web_search 不再依赖 DeepSeek 官方 API key。

title.zh: 分层记忆与上下文编排

description.en: Layered, inspectable memory for DSH: working memory, project archives and long-term evidence, with pluggable sources, strategies and nine storage backends.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的分层、可见记忆：工作记忆、项目档案与长期证据分离，来源与策略可插拔，本地存储或接入 8 种第三方 Provider。

description.en: Bridges CursorTouch/Windows-MCP into DSH through the built-in MCP client: screenshots, UI automation, input, clipboard, processes and registry, gated by a per-session switch.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 自带 MCP 桥接入 Windows-MCP：截屏、UI 自动化、输入、剪贴板、进程与注册表，默认关闭且按会话授权。

description.en: Archive, restore, favourite and permanently delete sessions, search archived message bodies, and clean up orphaned subagents.
description.zh: 归档、恢复、收藏和永久删除会话，支持正文全文检索与快速预览，并能清理孤儿子代理。

description.en: Turns a video into one addressable contact-sheet image with timestamps and ASR lines, so a text model can cite frames and zoom into a few seconds.
description.zh: 把视频压成一张可寻址的宫格图，带时间戳与台词，纯文本模型因此能引用某一格、再放大看某几秒。

description.en: Eight original skins plus wallpaper, accent colour and shareable theme packs, implemented purely on the native --dsw-* token surface.
description.zh: 8 套原创皮肤，外加壁纸、强调色与可分享主题包，全部走原生 --dsw-* token，不注入、不改安装包。

description.en: An interactive terminal UI for DSH sessions: streaming markdown, tool cards, slash and @ completion, history search, and a pixel-whale header.
description.zh: 在终端里跑 DSH 会话：流式 Markdown、工具卡片、斜杠与 @ 补全、历史搜索，外加像素鲸鱼首页。

description.en: Read-only dashboards for what your context is carrying: token/cost trends, context composition, per-agent fleet cards.
description.zh: 只读的上下文仪表盘：Token/成本趋势、上下文组成、每个子 Agent 一张卡片；它告诉你装了什么，不负责瘦身。

description.en: Blocks destructive commands and secret-file access before the tool runs; explicitly not a sandbox.
description.zh: 在工具执行前拦住删库、改权限、读 .env/SSH 私钥这类操作；它自己明说不是沙箱，别当安全边界。

description.en: Renders charts, tables, sliders and forms as interactive cards inside the conversation.
description.zh: 把图表、表格、滑块、表单画成会话里的可点卡片；纯展示秒回，带输入的要等你回答。

description.en: L0-L3 distillation pipeline that turns conversations into layered memories and recalls them before each model step.
description.zh: 把对话压成 L0 捕获→L1 原子记忆→L2 场景→L3 画像四层，并在每次模型调用前自动召回注入。

description.en: Per-session token budget with a hard stop before the next request, plus a usage ledger across vendors and models.
description.zh: 给每个会话设 Token 预算红线，到 100% 在下一步请求前直接停下；同时按供应商/模型/工作区统计用量。

description.en: Phone app connects back to the DSH on your own machine through a relay tunnel or LAN pairing.
description.zh: 手机 App 通过中转隧道或局域网连回你自己电脑上的 DSH；躺床上也能接着聊，但隧道会经过第三方。

description.en: Brings local Wallpaper Engine scenes, web and video wallpapers into the chat UI without registering tools or spending tokens.
description.zh: 把本机 Wallpaper Engine 的 Scene/Web/视频壁纸做成对话背景，不注册工具、不注入提示词，不花模型 token。

description.en: One place to manage skills across 20+ agent tools, with preview, backup and rollback.
description.zh: 把散落在 DSH / Claude Code / Cursor 等 20+ 工具里的技能集中管理，带预览、备份与回退。

description.en: Routes your locally signed-in WorkBuddy account into DSH's model picker; upstream already limits unofficial clients.
description.zh: 把本机登录的 WorkBuddy 账号接到 DSH 模型选择器；README 自述上游已限制非官方客户端，账号风险自担。

description.en: Replaces part of the official tool surface with terser, line-numbered output to cut token cost.
description.zh: 用更紧凑、带行号的返回替换部分官方工具，省 token；代价是工具面被换掉。

description.en: A role-based AI team workbench: lead, executor, reviewer, coder, designer, business.
description.zh: 带主理人/执行/验收/编程/设计/业务角色的三栏工作台，做的人与验收的人分开。

description.en: Notifications for approvals and finished replies, with optional forwarding to Discord, Bark, Feishu and webhooks.
description.zh: 审批/完成时弹通知、响铃、改标题；可选转发到 Discord/飞书/Bark 等，转发即内容出本机。

description.en: End-to-end encrypted remote access to your Harness, with agent tools for sessions and files.
description.zh: 端到端加密的远程接入，并给 Agent 一组会话/文件操作工具；授权设备等于第二把钥匙。

description.en: Timestamped memories that fade over time and only enter context when a query actually hits.
description.zh: 每条记忆带时间、会淡忘，只有当前这句话检索命中才注入上下文。

description.en: One-click stickers plus an AI that picks a meme for the mood; library can be self-built or installed from a market.
description.zh: 输入框一键发图、AI 按气氛接梗；图库可自建或从市场装，但会占用上下文。

description.en: Switchable persona cards per session or workspace, backed by markdown memory files the agent maintains.
description.zh: 会话级/工作区级可切换的人设卡，记忆存成 markdown 文件由模型读写；不保证模型真的去改。

description.en: A pet with 100+ transparent animations that reacts to session events, with pet packs and a standalone mode.
description.zh: 一百多个透明动画、跟随会话事件变状态，支持宠物包与脱离浏览器的桌面独立窗。

description.en: Corner widget that infers spending from balance drops, with per-turn cost bubbles and peak/off-peak pricing.
description.zh: 右下角常驻小鲸鱼：用余额下降反推消费，每轮结束弹消耗泡泡，含峰谷定价；不需要会话令牌。

title.zh: 壁纸引擎 + 桌宠 + 开机动画

description.en: A heavy atmosphere suite: WE wallpaper rendering, pet skins, boot animation, local voice and an online asset site.
description.zh: 氛围全家桶：WE 壁纸实时渲染、桌宠皮肤、开机动画、本地语音、在线素材站；注意 npm 包名是 dsh-folia。

description.en: A native always-on-top companion window that shows agent state and balance, started and stopped with DSH.
description.zh: 原生置顶小窗，随 DSH 启停，显示任务状态与余额；依赖 Python/PySide6，环境不对装不起来。

description.en: Turns replies into clickable interfaces: calculators, forms and charts whose results flow back into chat.
description.zh: 把回复变成可点的计算器/表单/图表，结果回流到对话；与 deep-view 同赛道。

description.en: Local-first SQLite memory with optional cloud sync, hot vault switching and resumable uploads.
description.zh: 本机 SQLite 记忆 + 可选云同步，支持热切换与断点续传；云同步即内容上云。

description.en: Connects DSH to an OpenViking server for recall, capture and viking:// URI memory.
description.zh: 接入 OpenViking 服务器做召回/捕获与 viking:// URI 记忆；没有服务端就等于装了没用。

description.en: Cross-session memory stored as markdown in git, plus a SOUL.md persona injected at session start.
description.zh: 记忆就是 markdown + git，SOUL.md 作人格，启动时硬注入；曾有“装了无法新建会话”的版本事故（0.19.2 已修）。

description.en: Read-only star map over other plugins' memory libraries, with 9 tools and single-file HTML export.
description.zh: 把别的插件的记忆只读聚合成关联星云，9 个工具顺链检索，可导出单文件 HTML。

description.en: One persona across QQ, Bilibili and Douyin with per-person memory, routines and proactive messages.
description.zh: 同一个“她”跨 QQ/B站/抖音，按人记忆、作息、主动开口；账号风险与隐私面最大。

description.en: Backs up and migrates the whole DSH config; can export API keys when encrypted — handle with care.
description.zh: 把整套 DSH 配置打成可移植备份，可加密导出密钥——这是它最大价值也是最大风险。

description.en: Pure-TypeScript OneBot 11 channel that turns DSH into a QQ bot; it is a channel, not a persona.
description.zh: 零 Python 的 OneBot 11 通道，让 QQ 消息进 Agent；它是通道不是人格，群聊里乱说话要自己配好设定。

title.zh: 每天刷一轮 B 站

description.en: Scrolls Bilibili daily, reads subtitles, writes a report and optionally comments with an @ to you.
description.zh: 每天搜 B 站、读字幕原文写报告，可选自动评论 @ 你；带本地转写要 1 GB，版本不满足时会被静默跳过。

description.en: One plugin connects a dozen IM platforms; install hits pnpm's build-script guard, landing half-installed.
description.zh: 一个插件接十几家 IM；实测因 pnpm 拦截 protobufjs 构建脚本，处于“半装”状态。

title.zh: 官方 QQ Bot 通道

description.en: Tencent's official QQ Bot channel, requires app registration; also blocked by the pnpm build-script guard.
description.zh: 走腾讯官方 QQ Bot 平台，合规更好但要先建机器人；同样被 pnpm 构建脚本拦截处于半装。

description.en: Watches a GitHub repo and wakes a session when something needs doing; credentials stay out of model context.
description.zh: 盯仓库、有事时唤醒会话处理，凭据不进模型上下文；实测因 pnpm 拦截处于半装。

description.en: Fail-closed permission gate with a P0-P4 decision chain: credentials, protected paths and dangerous shell are hard-denied.
description.zh: 确定性优先、默认拒绝的权限门：凭据/受保护路径/危险 shell 硬拒，P0 不可被任何规则或人工覆盖。

description.en: Keeps only an index in the prompt and pulls details on demand; empty library injects zero bytes.
description.zh: 提示词里只放索引（约 1.3k token），细节靠检索按需推门；空库注入 0 字节。

description.en: Sends only frames that actually changed, packed into one image; static screens cost almost nothing.
description.zh: 只传“画面变了”的帧并拼成一张图，静止屏幕几乎不出图；屏幕内容会进模型。

description.en: Read-only sidebar tab showing todo progress and files written this turn; needs dsh-better-sidebar to fully work.
description.zh: 只读侧栏：todo 三态进度 + 本轮产物文件；依赖 dsh-better-sidebar，且版本不匹配会被静默禁用。

description.en: Semantic icon identity across code and agent, stored in a diffable .icons.json.
description.zh: 给图标建语义身份：对话里写 <关闭> 就能取到同一个图；数据存在项目根的 .icons.json 里，可 diff。

description.en: Turns material into deliverable decks with 24 themes and editable PPTX export.
description.zh: 材料变可交付演示文稿：24 套主题、20 套行业蓝图，导出离线 HTML 与可编辑 PPTX，还能翻新旧 PPT。

description.en: Pauses requests during peak pricing hours, with weekend mode and per-session freeze.
description.zh: 高峰自动暂停、周末放行、按会话冻结并可后台重试；本质是省钱限流，急用时会觉得“AI 卡了”。

description.en: Parses PDFs via MinerU so the agent can cite text, formulas, tables and figures page by page.
description.zh: 用 MinerU 解析 PDF，Agent 能按证据读正文/公式/表格/插图并回原页核对；用官方云即文档上传。
